title: Senior Associate – Backend Engineer (Data Business CoE)
description:
**About us**

Bain & Company is a global management consulting that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

  
  

**Who you will work with**

* Pyxis combines alternative data, AI-driven analytics, and institutional investor-led insights to reveal where, how and why consumers buy, how they pay, how much they spend, how their needs and demands are changing, and much more.
* By revealing previously opaque fundamental business trends and their drivers, Pyxis enables investors and business decision makers to efficiently allocate capital and address critical problems.
* Pyxis has assembled one of the most comprehensive collections of alternative data covering hundreds of millions of people and tens of billions of transactions across the U.S., Canada, Brazil, UK, France and Japan as well as targeted countries across the EU and APAC. This data provides a longitudinal view of consumer and business transactional behaviors—across nearly all verticals over the last six years—and plays an integral role in answering companies’ and investors’ questions about market share, category size, pricing and promotion effectiveness, assortment optimization, ad targeting, loyalty, switching behavior, disruption, and more.
* These state-of-the art capabilities enable Bain to provide its clients with a valuable new dimension in investment analysis and strategy development, complementing Bain’s proven “outside-in” approach with the ability to apply complex data sets to assess company fundamentals.
* BCN Pyxis modeler will work closely with the BCN team manager, Pyxis Product Manager, General Manager, Bain Partners, and the Proprietary Data group to build and deliver a commercially successful product that spans core sectors across all regions.
* The working style of the team would be to support Pyxis product development , hence the pipelines and algorithm built should be scalable and automated to support subscription clients
  

  

**What you’ll do**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI.
* Build high-performance APIs capable of handling large datasets, complex queries, and data-intensive workloads.
* Work across workstreams to deliver high-quality, zero-defect deliverables and leverage manager’s support on complex pieces
* Gather requirements from product managers and business users and translate them into technical designs and well-scoped backend solutions
* Provide technical guidance, code reviews and mentoring to junior team members
* Work extensively with SQL databases (Snowflake,Straburst) for complex data extraction, transformation, manipulation, and analysis.
* Optimize SQL queries, database schemas, indexing, and data processing pipelines for performance and scalability.
* Develop efficient data wrangling and processing workflows to handle large, structured and semi-structured datasets.
* Integrate backend services with external APIs, databases, AI models, and other enterprise systems.
* Implement robust authentication, authorization, API security, data encryption, and secure coding practices.
* Work with cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes.
* Ensure backend reliability through proper logging, monitoring, error handling, testing, and performance optimization.
* Collaborate with frontend developers, data scientists, and AI engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions.

  

**About you**

* Work experience: 6+ years of experience in backend or data engineering, with hands-on experience building production-grade services using Python, SQL and AWS

* Education Required: Incumbent should be a graduate/post graduate from top-tier institute or have pursued a statistical/analytical course from a tier 1 university

Preferred: Concentration in a quantitative discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science, Econometrics, Business Analytics, or Market Research is strongly preferred.

  
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on experience with Python and FastAPI for backend application development.
* Excellent SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query optimization, and handling large datasets.
* Experience with data manipulation and wrangling using Python libraries such as Pandas or Polars.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, asynchronous programming, and backend architecture.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD, and application deployment.
* Understanding of backend security fundamentals, including OAuth2, JWT, RBAC, API security, secrets management, and data protection.
* Familiarity with Git, unit testing, debugging, and production-grade software engineering practices.

  

**Good to Have / Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to Generative AI / LLM-based applications, including OpenAI APIs, Azure OpenAI, or similar services.
* Understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, and AI-powered backend integrations.
* Familiarity with Redis, Celery, message queues, and background job processing.
* Experience with Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, or cloud-native architectures.

  

**What makes us a great place to work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Software Development Engineer - BackEnd (Staff - Level 4) | Gurugram, IND
description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

title: T&T | EAD | Agentic AI- Backend | Delhi & Mumbai | Engineering | PDI
description:
**T\&T \| EAD \| Agentic AI\- Backend \| Delhi \& Mumbai \| Engineering \| PDI**
  

* **Job requisition ID** : 112404
* **Location**: Delhi
* **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team**
------------

  



Deloitte’s Technology \& Transformation practice can help organizations uncover and unlock value through innovative technology, data, cloud, and AI solutions. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services that help businesses modernize their technology landscape, build scalable digital platforms, and accelerate AI\-led transformation. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities across cloud, data, artificial intelligence, analytics, software engineering, and next\-generation technologies.

  



Deloitte is building an Agentic Platform \& Applications for the enterprise – the backend infrastructure that enables businesses to create, deploy, integrate, and operate AI agents at scale in a regulated fintech environment.

  


**Your work profile**
---------------------

  



We are seeking a strong backend/platform engineer to build and scale the core infrastructure powering enterprise AI agents and applications. The ideal candidate will have solid software engineering fundamentals, experience with distributed systems and cloud\-native architectures, and an interest in building production\-grade AI agent platforms.

  



The role will involve:

  


* Building backend services for agent creation, configuration, deployment, execution, sessions, state, memory, and lifecycle – the full runtime stack.


* Designing and implementing agent and service orchestration capabilities, including asynchronous processing, routing, retries, timeouts, and reliable error handling across multi\-agent workflows.


* Integrating LLMs, Agent SDKs such as Google ADK and LangGraph, MCP services, and A2A agents through clean, scalable platform APIs.


* Connecting AI agents with enterprise applications and services through scalable and versioned APIs.


* Building end\-to\-end production observability using OpenTelemetry, including tracing across agent, model, tool, and service execution.


* Deploying and operating platform services on Kubernetes / GKE / GCP with appropriate security, CI/CD, scalability, and production reliability practices.


* Working closely with architects, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders to design and deliver scalable enterprise AI capabilities.


* Taking end\-to\-end ownership of platform components, from design and development through deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

  


**Key skills required**
-----------------------

  



✓ 4–6 years of solid experience in backend or platform engineering.



✓ Strong programming experience in Python, with hands\-on experience building production\-grade backend services using FastAPI or similar frameworks.



✓ Strong understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous programming, microservices, REST APIs, and scalable backend architectures.



✓ Experience building APIs, developer platforms, orchestration systems, or distributed applications. Experience in AI is beneficial but not mandatory if the candidate has strong transferable platform engineering experience.



✓ Some hands\-on exposure to AI agents, Agent SDKs, MCP, A2A, LLM\-based applications, or related AI technologies.



✓ Experience with cloud\-native architecture and deployment on GCP / GKE, Kubernetes, and Docker.



✓ Understanding of CI/CD, authentication, security, production reliability, and cloud infrastructure practices.



✓ Experience with production observability, distributed tracing, and tools such as OpenTelemetry, OPIK, or Langfuse.



✓ Strong understanding of databases and data stores, including PostgreSQL, Redis, and familiarity with vector databases.



✓ Strong problem\-solving, communication, collaboration, and ownership mindset.



✓ Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment and take end\-to\-end ownership of technical deliverables.

  


**Technology Stack**
--------------------

  


### **Platform**

  


* Python
* FastAPI
* REST APIs
* Async
* Microservices
* Auth

### **Agents**


* Google ADK
* LangGraph
* MCP
* A2A
* Agent Runtime

### **LLMs**


* OpenAI
* Gemini
* Anthropic
* Model Gateway / Streaming

### **Infrastructure**


* GCP
* GKE
* Kubernetes
* Docker
* CI/CD

### **Observability**


* OpenTelemetry
* Distributed Tracing
* OPIK / Langfuse

### **Data**


* PostgreSQL
* Redis
* Vector DBs

**Qualifications**
------------------

  



Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
